model_scope: Synthetic dimensionless teaching model. Numeric parameters are software assumptions, not patient estimates.

parameters.name: uptake_rate
parameters.definition: Baseline fatty-acid-like input term in the synthetic FFA derivative.
parameters.source: No source supports the numeric value. Qualitative motivation only: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39583092/
parameters.validity: Toy equation only; not measured in any population.
parameters.sensitivity: One-at-a-time ±20% probes are reported in the API and synthetic experiment report.

parameters.name: dnl_rate
parameters.definition: Baseline de-novo-lipogenesis-like input term in the synthetic FFA derivative.
parameters.source: No source supports the numeric value. Qualitative motivation only: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25740151/
parameters.validity: Toy equation only; not measured in any population.
parameters.sensitivity: One-at-a-time ±20% probes are reported in the API and synthetic experiment report.

parameters.name: beta_oxidation_rate
parameters.definition: Synthetic FFA oxidation term, multiplied by relative oxygen and a saturating FFA factor.
parameters.source: No source supports the numeric value, oxygen multiplier, or saturation constant. Qualitative motivation: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39583092/
parameters.validity: Toy equation only; not calibrated to liver measurements.
parameters.sensitivity: One-at-a-time ±20% probes are reported in the API and synthetic experiment report.

parameters.name: initial_ffa
parameters.definition: Initial free-fatty-acid-like state for each synthetic zone.
parameters.source: Arbitrary visualization initial condition; no empirical source.
parameters.sensitivity: Initial-condition scale sweep at 0.5×, 1.0× and 1.5× is reported.

parameters.name: initial_triglyceride
parameters.definition: Initial triglyceride-like state for each synthetic zone.
parameters.source: Arbitrary visualization initial condition; no empirical source.
parameters.sensitivity: Initial-condition scale sweep at 0.5×, 1.0× and 1.5× is reported.

parameters.name: initial_ros
parameters.definition: Initial reactive-oxygen-species-like state for each synthetic zone.
parameters.source: Arbitrary visualization initial condition; no empirical source.
parameters.validity: Synthetic demonstration only; not a ROS assay.
parameters.sensitivity: Initial-condition scale sweep at 0.5×, 1.0× and 1.5× is reported.

parameters.name: initial_ecm
parameters.definition: Initial extracellular-matrix-like state for each synthetic zone.
parameters.source: Arbitrary visualization initial condition; no empirical source.
parameters.validity: Synthetic demonstration only; not a fibrosis measurement.
parameters.sensitivity: Initial-condition scale sweep at 0.5×, 1.0× and 1.5× is reported.

parameters.name: ode_loss_and_transfer_coefficients
parameters.definition: Fixed coefficients in dFFA, dTG, dROS and dECM synthetic equations.
parameters.range: Not empirically estimated; no validated range assigned.
parameters.source: Equation form and coefficients are synthetic. Qualitative mechanism context is described in docs/PARAMETERS.md.
parameters.validity: Equation-recovery benchmark only, not a biological mechanism simulator.
parameters.sensitivity: Not individually varied in current sensitivity analysis.

parameters.name: oxygen_gradient
parameters.definition: Relative zonal oxygen multiplier from zone 1 to zone 5.
parameters.range: Fixed illustrative gradient; not a measured physiological range.
parameters.source: Broad qualitative motivation: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31537830/ . The selected values are invented.
parameters.sensitivity: Not individually varied in current sensitivity analysis.

parameters.name: oxygen_pde_coefficients
parameters.definition: One-dimensional explicit teaching PDE velocity, diffusivity, uptake and fixed boundaries.
parameters.unit: arbitrary transport units; displayed boundaries use mmHg labels for visual context only
parameters.range: Not empirically estimated; solver bounds the explicit time step for numerical stability.
parameters.source: No source supports these numeric values or geometry.
parameters.validity: Teaching PDE only; not physiologically calibrated.
parameters.sensitivity: Grid refinement at 21, 41 and 81 cells is reported.
